_scaffold_note: First general-sweep map, route mode. Player = generic HP-bar anchor (no character). Mobs = models/mob_generic.pt. attack_range/aoe_max/gather numbers are starting guesses.
_player_note: HP-bar anchor shape for this map: your floating HP bar is ~7-8px tall (width varies with HP%, ~43-56 seen). The default accepted any red blob 2-16px tall, so near the map ends (camera clamped, you off-center) it grabbed STOP-sign mob parts, the red medal banner under your name (12px), bin signs and mob HP bars (4px), and damage numbers. Checked on the 646 captured frames. Remaining weak spot: big damage numbers covering your bar mid-attack.
_gather_note: z = push/gather (path-scoop) skill, 1s cooldown: dashes forward and scoops mobs along the path into a clump within attack_range, doubling as forward locomotion. grp/min/dash_gap are starting guesses: grp=how spread mobs must be to bother scooping, min=fewest mobs worth a scoop, dash_gap=attack_range - dash reach. Tune live.
_minimap_note: Minimap crop measured from a capture frame. The recording showed the same minimap x at the same place every lap (start ~43, portal ~214, jump ~195), so route until_x waypoints are stable despite the wide map.
_map_box_note: Valid minimap-dot box [x_min,x_max,y_min,y_max]. y_min 48 rejects the phantom reads seen in the recording (y 5-40 is not a platform level); levels are y~55 (upper), 62-84 (right platforms/slope), 99-109 (bottom).
_buff_note: Same buff groups as deep_sea_2 (d 5min, 3 10min, g 15min, 1 10min); each group fires on its own interval. Re-enabled 2026-09-24 after testing.
_route_note: Recorded from a human run (routes/flat_sweep.capture.jsonl, cycle t 0.7-81.6s) via build_sweep_route.py, then hand-tuned. Start the character at bottom-left (minimap x~43). Segments 2 and 5 take the SAME bottom portal (lands upper x~135): UP at x=219 (recorded 216/214/212, moved right). After the 1st portal she heads straight right (the recorded upper-left detour to 107 is dropped); after the 2nd she goes left to 45 and drops to the start. Segment 3 ends in 'edge_jump': the minimap dot PINS at x=195 while the minimap scrolls, so past it she fights and steps on until she walks off the upper platform (minimap y drops), then air-jumps. Segment 6 (upper floor, left from the portal exit ~135 to 45) ATTACKS: after the 1st portal she heads right, so mobs left of the exit are behind her; the 2nd pass (segment 6) walks left over them.
_band_note: Only mobs whose feet are within this many screen px above/below her feet count (sweep decide is x-only). Levels here are ~600px apart, so 180 separates them. Without it she FIREd forever at upper-floor mobs in x-range. Override one side with band_up / band_down.
_rhythm_note: Route attack legs: one z push, wait push_settle_secs, then HOLD x for aoe_hold_secs (continuous AoE). x hold 1.05s = 2 casts (recording median 1.06s; 1.6s = 3 casts was tried). z->x gap recording median 0.61s includes human reaction; 0.3 used. Push cooldown 1.5s: a push decided while it is still cooling down walks forward instead until it is ready. No push within push_edge_margin minimap px of the segment end (edge/portal/jump spot) -- AoE only. No mob on her level -> walk. Every push is preceded by a 0.2 s walk and fired while still moving (push_prewalk_secs): a push from a standstill sometimes glitched.
_portal_note: Both portal legs walk LEFT into the same bottom portal. Measured with locate_player.py (2026-09-24): UP worked at x=215 walking LEFT into it, x=213 walking RIGHT (the spot reads ~2 px differently by arrival side). Route stops at 215 +-1 (portal_tol). The line-up (sweep.approach_x) always ARRIVES moving left, taking over portal_lead (20) px early; if already past it she backs up 6 px and comes back in leftwards.
_mob_conf_note: 0.4 -> 0.6 (2026-09-24): she attacked air. Replaying the loop's decision on the 646 saved frames showed boxes on dropped loot (meso bags) and on AoE effects over dying mobs. On the labeled frames, 0.6 drops 36 -> 8 false boxes and keeps 96% of real mobs.
_debug_note: debug_log: per-beat decision trace -> logs/debug_<ts>.log + every attack's annotated frame -> logs/sweep_dbg/ (max debug_max_frames=400). Turn off once tuned.
_recovery_note: Each segment's y = its floor's minimap y (build_sweep_route.py). If she walks stuck_secs (4) with no progress -- e.g. a failed jump left her on the bottom, whose right end (~285) never reaches segment 5's 307 -- the loop resyncs to the next segment on the floor she is on (bottom-right -> segment 6, the portal leg). Minimap reads jumping > 40 px within 2 s are phantoms.
_jump_note: Edge jump (segment 3): the upper platform slopes down (minimap y 55 -> ~62) to the gap; she jumps ONCE when the minimap y reaches level+5 (the slope bottom, where the recorded laps pressed), level = the segment's y (55), never her current height (re-basing made it fire after she walked off the lower lip). No facing tap before AoE in the zone (it stepped her off the lip). Pushes stop 15 minimap px before a segment end (a push moves ~13 px).
_anchor_reseed_note: HP-bar tracker: after every transition it is re-seeded at her usual screen spot for the floor she is on (median of recent positions on that floor). A lock whose screen x moves >= 40 px AGAINST the heading for 2 beats while the minimap advances is scenery (a STOP-sign sliver) -> re-seed. After a portal she waits portal_settle_secs (0.5, trying shorter; the camera pan lasts ~1.5 s and the drift check catches a bad lock during the rest).
